postings.text:

With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and motivated Accounts Payable Analyst to support our global Accounts Payable operations within our Center of Excellence in Bengaluru, India.

This role will support day-to-day AP activities including invoice processing, payment support, vendor management, travel & expense, and AP help desk inquiries. The ideal candidate is eager to learn, highly organized, and committed to accuracy, timely processing, and providing excellent service to internal and external stakeholders.

During onboarding, the role may align with U.S. business hours before transitioning to standard IST hours in a hybrid model.

Technologies You’ll Use

• Coupa (preferred)

• NetSuite (preferred)

• Navan or similar T&E platform

• Google Workspace

• Microsoft Excel

What You’ll Do

• Process invoices accurately and timely, including 2-way matching

• Review invoice discrepancies and work with vendors and internal teams to resolve issues

• Assist with payment runs, including ACH and wire payments, following established controls and procedures

• Support vendor setup and maintenance, including required validations and documentation

• Review employee expense reports for compliance with company policies

• Respond to AP help desk inquiries and support established service-level expectations

• Assist with month-end close activities, including accrual support and account reconciliations

• Work collaboratively with Accounting, Procurement, FP&A, and other internal teams

• Assist with audit requests and maintain accurate supporting documentation

• Identify opportunities to improve AP processes and participate in process improvement and automation initiatives

• Maintain accurate and organized AP records in accordance with company policies and procedures

Skills We’re Looking For

• 1–2 years of Accounts Payable, Accounting, Finance, or related experience

• Basic understanding of the Accounts Payable lifecycle

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

• Ability to organize and prioritize tasks in a high-volume environment

• Basic to intermediate Microsoft Excel skills

• Experience with ERP, accounting, or AP systems is preferred

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work collaboratively with internal teams and external vendors

• Willingness to learn new systems, processes, and accounting concepts

• Ability to meet deadlines and follow established procedures and controls

KPIs / Success Metrics

• Invoice processing turnaround time

• Invoice processing accuracy

• On-time payment support

• AP help desk SLA adherence

• Timely resolution of invoice and vendor inquiries

• Reduction in processing errors and escalations

Optional (Bonus Skills)

• Experience with Coupa, NetSuite, or similar ERP/AP platforms

• Experience in a shared services or Center of Excellence environment

• Exposure to SOX controls or audit processes

• Experience with travel & expense platforms

• Interest in process improvement and automation

• Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

• RSU stock grants*

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Global Payroll Analyst to support accurate, timely, and compliant payroll operations across our global workforce. Based in India and reporting to a manager in the United States, this role will have a primary focus on processing U.S. payroll in Workday while also supporting India payroll, employees engaged through Employer of Record (EOR) and Professional Employer Organization (PEO) arrangements, and payroll activities in other countries.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on payroll professional who can move comfortably between payroll processing, audits, vendor coordination, reconciliations, and employee support. This position requires a high degree of accuracy, sound judgment, strong follow-through, and the ability to work effectively across time zones and cultures. The work schedule will include regular overlap with U.S. business hours, either Pacific or Eastern time, as business needs require.

What You’ll Do

• Process multi-state U.S. payroll for exempt and non-exempt employees using Workday Payroll, including regular wages, bonuses, commissions, equity transactions, leaves, and final payments.

• Perform end-to-end payroll activities, including reviewing inputs, validating calculations, running audits, resolving discrepancies, preparing payroll registers, and supporting payroll approval and settlement.

• Coordinate payroll for workers engaged through EOR and PEO providers.

• Support India payroll processing and review, including payroll inputs, statutory deductions and contributions, employee changes, terminations, reconciliations, and coordination with local payroll partners.

• Monitor payroll cases and ticket queues; respond to employee questions regarding pay, taxes, deductions, benefits, time off, and payroll timing with accuracy, empathy, and clear ownership through resolution.

• Partner with payroll vendors and internal teams to investigate and resolve payroll issues, track open items, meet cutoffs, and ensure timely follow-through.

• Support payroll accounting activities, including payroll journals, accruals, and investigation of payroll-to-general-ledger differences.

• Maintain payroll documentation, calendars, checklists, standard operating procedures, and country-specific process information to support controls and cross-training.

• Assist with internal and external audits, SOX controls, year-end activities, statutory reporting, and other payroll compliance requirements.

• Contribute to payroll implementations, integrations, testing, process improvements, and automation initiatives across Workday and the broader global payroll environment.

• Build trusted relationships with HR, HRIS, Accounting, Finance, Tax, Benefits, Equity, Legal, and external payroll partners across regions and time zones.

Skills We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of payroll experience, including hands-on responsibility for payroll processing, audits, reconciliations, and employee support.

• 3+ years of hands-on U.S. payroll processing experience using Workday Payroll and Workday Time Tracking.

• Working knowledge of U.S. federal, state, and local payroll taxation and wage-and-hour requirements, including multi-state payroll.

• Hands-on India payroll experience, including familiarity with common statutory payroll requirements and local payroll practices.

• Experience supporting payroll through EOR and/or PEO providers across multiple countries.

• Experience managing employee inquiries through a case-management or ticketing system and communicating complex payroll topics clearly.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, formulas, data validation, and reconciliation of large data sets.

• Demonstrated attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and success meeting multiple payroll deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across time zones.

• Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and sound judgment.

• Ability to work a schedule that provides regular overlap with U.S. Pacific or Eastern business hours.

• Experience with ADP SmartCompliance.

• Experience supporting payroll operations in additional countries or regions beyond the United States and India.

• Payroll accounting experience, including journals, accruals, and general ledger reconciliation.

• Experience with payroll implementations, acquisitions, integrations, user acceptance testing, or process automation.

• Experience working in a SOX-controlled and high-growth global environment.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Corporate Accounting to lead our corporate accounting function and help shape the next generation of our Finance organization. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for the day-to-day General Ledger (GL) accounting function while also serving as a key transformation leader across Accounting and Finance.
The ideal candidate combines strong accounting expertise with a builder's mindset. You will ensure an accurate, timely, and well-controlled close while rethinking how accounting work gets done—simplifying processes, improving systems and data, expanding automation, and driving practical adoption of AI across the accounting organization.
This role requires a leader who can operate at both strategic and detailed levels, from defining the future-state accounting operating model to solving complex accounting, process, and systems challenges.

What You'll Do

Lead Corporate Accounting

• Own corporate accounting operations, including the General Ledger, month-end and quarter-end close, reconciliations, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, intercompany, and related activities.

• Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, ensuring financial results are accurate, well-supported, controlled, and delivered on time.

• Maintain a strong internal control environment and build processes that scale with the growth and complexity of the business.

• Partner closely with Technical Accounting, Revenue, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Payroll, Legal, IT, and other teams on accounting and business matters.

• Support external audits and financial reporting requirements.

Drive Transformation & AI Adoption

• Serve as a transformation leader for Accounting, developing and executing a roadmap for a more automated, scalable, and data-driven organization.

• Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, accelerate the close, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and standardize processes.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives involving accounting systems, financial data, integrations, workflow automation, and process redesign.

• Champion the responsible adoption of AI across Accounting, identifying and implementing high-value use cases that improve productivity, quality, and employee experience.

• Build AI capabilities across the team through training, experimentation, and best-practice sharing while establishing appropriate governance and human oversight.

• Establish metrics to measure improvements in close performance, automation, productivity, and quality.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Team

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing accounting team capable of operating effectively in a fast-growing SaaS/Data environment.

• Develop future leaders by increasing ownership and building stronger accounting, technology, and business capabilities across the team.

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement where the team challenges existing processes and embraces technology, automation, and new ways of working.

• Balance operational excellence with transformation, ensuring the organization executes reliably while continuously improving how work gets done.

What We're Looking For

• 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including leadership of corporate or GL accounting functions within a public company or similarly complex environment.

• 4+ years of people leadership experience; experience managing managers preferred.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

• Deep knowledge of U.S. GAAP, financial close processes, internal controls, and accounting operations.

• Experience within a SaaS, software, technology, or data business strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated success leading meaningful Accounting or Finance transformation initiatives.

• Strong systems orientation with experience improving ERP, close management, reconciliation, workflow, or other Finance technology platforms.

• Strong understanding of AI and automation and an ability to translate emerging capabilities into practical accounting applications.

• Excellent project management, change leadership, and executive communication skills.

• Ability to move seamlessly between strategy and execution and influence stakeholders across Finance and the broader organization.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role goes beyond delivering an accurate close. You will help build an accounting organization that is increasingly automated, intelligent, scalable, and forward-looking.
You will create a more efficient and predictable close, reduce reliance on manual processes, embed AI and automation into how the team operates, and build a strong leadership bench. Ultimately, this role will help define what a modern Accounting organization should look like in an AI-enabled SaaS/Data company.

• Improve how this work gets done — better data models, less manual assembly, and AI applied to recurring analysis.

• Experience owning an operating expense budget, or partnering with a non-finance organization on its spend.

• Strong modeling skills across both driver-based revenue forecasts and operating expense and headcount models.

• Working knowledge of software and subscription economics — ARR, NRR, ARPA, expansion, gross margin — ideally in a usage-based business.

• Comfort working directly with large and complex datasets. SQL proficiency strongly preferred.

• Ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation and present it to Product, Support, and senior leadership.

• Interest in how software gets built and what it costs to run.

• Product or Engineering finance partnership at a software, data infrastructure, or developer tools company.

• Hands-on product margin, cost of revenue, or cost-to-serve analysis.

• Experience supporting a Customer Support, Services, or other cost-to-serve organization.

• Usage-based pricing, packaging, or monetization modeling.

• Planning and BI tools (Pigment, Looker, Tableau, Sigma) and lightweight automation in Python or SQL.

• Experience through a period of rapid scaling or IPO preparation.
